claim: Goldman Sachs reported total assets under supervision of $4,097bn at 30 September 2026, of which liquidity products were $1,051bn, fixed income $1,405bn, equity $1,150bn and alternative investments $491bn.

claim: Asset & Wealth Management net revenues were $5,051m in 3Q26, with management and other fees of $3,587m, attributed mainly to higher average AUS.

claim: Goldman Sachs describes itself as having 'over $706 billion in total alternative assets' (August 2026 boilerplate) and, earlier, 'over $625 billion' (January 2026).
